evals.prompt: Set this project up — I want to build a tool for freelance translators who juggle several clients: they track jobs, deadlines, and what they are owed, so they need their own account and their data saved. Chat with me in English, use the App preset, and skip the brand pass (keep neutral). I am not available to answer anything else — make sensible decisions yourself, say what you decided, and take the flow all the way through Step 5.
evals.expected_output: An idea doc and PRD for an accounts-and-database product, the App preset recorded in docs/manifest.md, Step 4c applying the App preset's modules (persistence and observability), a domain schema plus factories/seed, and no gridfin:fill markers left.
expectations: The fit check runs (and passes) before docs/idea.md is written
docs/manifest.md's ## Preset field is filled with App and its gridfin:fill marker removed
Step 4c runs `pnpm module:apply persistence` AND `pnpm module:apply observability` — both modules the App preset lists — rather than a hard-coded single module
docs/manifest.md's ## Installed modules field lists both persistence and observability
After the modules are applied, src/db/ and src/middleware.ts exist (persistence landed) and a Sentry instrumentation file exists (observability landed)
Step 4d/4e add domain tables and factories on top of the applied schema, not before it — the module apply precedes any src/db/schema.ts edit
docs/manifest.md no longer contains gridfin:fill markers when the flow completes

evals.prompt: Set this project up for a solo photographer's portfolio — just a page showing their work and a contact form, no accounts needed. Chat with me in English and skip the brand pass (keep neutral). I am not available to answer anything else — make sensible decisions yourself, say what you decided, and take the flow all the way through Step 5.
evals.expected_output: An idea doc and PRD reflecting a no-backend product, a preset choice of Landing recorded in docs/manifest.md, and Step 4 running only the module-skip and rename/brand/manifest sub-steps (no domain schema, factories, or auth mode).
expectations: The preset is decided only after the fit check passes, and is recorded as Landing (the eval runs headless, so a self-decided preset stated aloud counts — what must not happen is choosing it before the fit check)
docs/manifest.md's ## Preset field is filled with Landing and its gridfin:fill marker removed
docs/manifest.md's ## Installed modules field is filled (empty/none) and its gridfin:fill marker removed
No `pnpm module:apply` command is run for a Landing preset
Step 4's domain-schema, factory/seed, and auth-mode sub-steps are skipped (not attempted and marked N.A., or skip-committed) for a Landing preset
Step 5's handover is the Landing one: no `/signin` or `/dashboard` smoke check, no database check, no seeded-admin credentials
